content: Nonetheless, GANs have continued to show their value particularly in the domain of text-generation. Of particular interest for our purposes, Radford et al. propose synthesizing images from text descriptions [3]. The group demonstrates how GANs can produce images that correspond to a user-defined text description. It thus seems feasible that by using a similar model, we can produce text samples that are conditioned upon a set of user-specified keywords.
